prompt_markdown: Your team is shipping a family registration script with AI help.
Which of these is fine to delegate to the tool?
hint: Separate the typing a tool can do from the decisions about people that you must own.

options.text: Choosing how long the script keeps family records.
Confirming the script handles messy input before it goes live.
Signing off that the script is ready to go live.
Drafting boilerplate for a function you already designed.
